minimumBlockers.risk: New personal nutrition data would have no functioning recurring backup and no demonstrated populated recovery point.
minimumBlockers.existingGap: Backup code rejects every nonzero USER_OWNED_TABLES count (including account_activations), requires zero Auth users/identities/sessions/refresh tokens, and pins total food/catalog counts to the bootstrap fixture. PR #166 records one owner and one completed activation. Therefore the next unchanged backup reaches a deterministic rejection before archive creation; no live failure was queried or executed.
minimumBlockers.smallestTask: One bounded corrective task: replace bootstrap zero-user/zero-owned-row and fixed mixed catalog-count assumptions with safe populated-owner validation; preserve exact project, encryption, redaction, Storage and migration guards; prove encrypted capture and isolated restore of synthetic populated Auth, activation, diary snapshots/targets and custom-food data. Separately authorize/adopt a successful scheduled backup after the real owner exists; no 8-hour timing certification or repeated drills are needed to close this blocker.
minimumBlockers.whyBeforeOwnerUse: Every successful existing artifact predates owner creation and contains no owner nutrition rows. Starting sustained diary use while capture deterministically rejects populated state creates a realistic data-loss risk on Supabase Free.
minimumBlockers.remainingGap: No real Production owner-state backup was captured or adopted in this local-only task.
